import json,glob,os
files=sorted(glob.glob('predictions/*.json'))
print(files[-1] if files else 'none')
latest={}
for f in files:
    for e in json.load(open(f)):
        latest[e['question_id']]=e['outcomes']
print(len(latest))
import csv
rows={r['qid']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('market.csv'))}
hi=[(max(v.values()),k,max(v,key=v.get)) for k,v in latest.items()]
hi.sort(reverse=True)
for p,q,o in hi[:45]:
    t=rows[q]['title'][:80] if q in rows else '?'
    print(round(p,2), q, o[:28].ljust(28), t)
